messages:
elaine (growth): Heads-up — Bloomberg reached out asking for a short comment on today's benchmark blog before embargo. Can we move fast?

sam (content): Wait — our publish schedule is still set for 06:00 PT tomorrow right? not today?

mira (pr): Correct, embargo is tomorrow 06:00 PT. Reporter says they may run early if they get a quote. Need a decision on 'go/no-go' for releasing a comment.

jon (product): Why do they need a quote vs just the benchmark link? Any ask specifics?

mira (pr): They want a 1-2 line CEO reaction and a sentence on methodology. Quote + 1 sentence on how we validated latency across regions.

elaine (growth): From a comms POV, giving a short, controlled quote is fine as long as embargo stays. We should give a holding quote that doesn't reveal numbers.

tanya (legal): I'll quick-review any quote. No promises on legal turnaround but can do ~30–45 mins if it's short.

sam (content): Draft of holding quote: "We're excited to share results from our latest inference benchmarks — they reflect months of optimization across models and infrastructure and help customers choose cost-effective serving configs." Thoughts?

mira (pr): Good start. Make it tighter: "These benchmarks reflect months of optimization across models and infrastructure and help customers pick cost-effective serving configs." Remove 'excited' — sounds softer.

jon (product): Add one sentence on methodology in plain language: "We measured latency and cost across common production workloads, with deterministic routing and batch-aware configs."

sam (content): OK combined draft: \"These benchmarks reflect months of optimization across models and infrastructure and help customers pick cost-effective serving configs. We measured latency and cost across representative production workloads, using deterministic routing and batch-aware configurations.\"

elaine (growth): +1. Mira, can you offer this to Bloomberg under embargo with the caveat they not publish until 06:00 PT tomorrow?

mira (pr): I'll send it now with embargo language. Using email template: 
```
Per embargo, content is not for publication or attribution until 06:00 PT on <date>. Quoted text is approved by Redwood Inference for use at embargo lift.
```

press-bot: :inbox_tray: Email to reporter sent (ID: 2026-03-23-457).

tanya (legal): Quick note — change "representative production workloads" to "representative production workloads we commonly see" to avoid implying exhaustive coverage. Approving otherwise.

sam (content): Updated: \"...using deterministic routing and batch-aware configurations we commonly see in production.\"

elaine (growth): Social team — hold on drafting owned channels until we get final asset links. But prepare shorter tweet idea: "New inference benchmarks: see how models compare on latency & cost — blog tomorrow 06:00 PT." Add link + UTM later.

mira (pr): Also flag: if Bloomberg runs early, we ask that they not include raw tables before embargo. I've added that in the email.

jon (product): One more ask: can eng attach a one-paragraph method note we can paste into journalists' emails? Saves back-and-forth.

sam (content): I'll paste a 3-sentence methods blurb in the thread in 5m.

press-bot: :white_check_mark: Reporter replied: "We'll hold to embargo but may publish an early read if new data arrives — will confirm after they get your note."

mira (pr): Good. If anything changes, we'll escalate to exec comms. Thanks everyone — sending final now with Tanya's tweak.

elaine (growth): Great work — keep this thread updated if we get pickup or need to escalate to execs.

sam (content): Methods blurb (copy/paste): "We benchmarked inference across multiple open and curated models using a standardized suite of production-like prompts. Latency was measured end-to-end across regions with identical routing policies; cost estimates used tokenized workloads and batch-aware execution to reflect typical deployment settings. Results focus on comparative trends rather than absolute figures for any single customer workload."

mira (pr): Perfect — included that in the email. Closing thread unless we hear back.

elaine (growth): Leaving pinned note for social ops to prep assets once blog link is live. :pin:
